sites.evidence_type: N-terminal HA epitope; parallel surface-display screen
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface immunostaining PME 1031.2 ± 265.7 (HA immunostaining, Tedman deep receptor scanning)
sites.rationale: Experimentally validated N-terminal HA epitope insertion (after signal-peptide cleavage where present); surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in Tedman et al. deep receptor scanning.

sources.citation: Tedman et al., Efficient experimental characterization of the GPCRome via deep receptor scanning, Nat Commun 2026 (bioRxiv 2025.09.19.677468, PMC12458215)
sources.claim: N-terminal HA epitope inserted per receptor; surface expression read out by HA immunostaining in a pooled GPCRome deep-receptor-scanning screen.

sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: FACS surface labeling with FITC-anti-HA under non-permeabilized conditions confirmed cell-surface display (L3, L6). Ligand binding function reported unaffected (L7). Receptor trafficking and intracellular localization reported unaffected (L2, L5). Validation_level: surface_and_function.
sites.rationale: ADRA2C is a GPCR with no signal peptide; the raw topology string begins with 'O' (extracellular) at position 1, confirming M1 is the sole extracellular N-terminus. All ledger lines (L1–L8) describe the tag at the 'extreme amino terminus' with no residue number, so the position is topology-derived: insert_after_residue=0, residue_after=M (position 1, confirmed by code). The tag is 50 residues from TM1 (positions 51–77), well beyond the ≥3-residue minimum. Multiple independent labs confirmed surface display and preserved ligand-binding function, yielding the highest validation level. Multiple independent studies (PMC4035122, PMC2919199, PMC10744278) express full-length, membrane-anchored human/murine α2C AR with an HA epitope tag (YPYDVPDYA) at the 'extreme amino terminus'. No residue number is stated; ADRA2C has no signal peptide (topology residue 1 = O, extracellular), so exactly one extracellular terminus exists and the tag prepends before M1. Surface display was confirmed by FITC-conjugated anti-HA antibody labeling under non-permeabilized conditions (FACS). Pharmacological function (ligand binding) and intracellular localization were reported unchanged.

sources.claim: Since no commercially available antisera were available against extracellular epitopes of either WT α2 ARs, an HA epitope was introduced into the extreme amino terminus of all WT and variant forms of α2 ARs.

literature_notes: L9 and L10 (PMC10744278) describe a C-terminal EGFP fusion ('coding region fused in frame with EGFP'). The C-terminus of ADRA2C falls in the intracellular region 441–462 (topology landmark), so this is not an extracellular surface-tag site; it is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line grounds a tag in any of the short extracellular loops (ECL1 115–124, ECL2 191–208, ECL3 408–418), so no internal sites are proposed. L1–L8 all converge on the same N-terminal prepend junction; they are treated as corroborating evidence for one site, not separate sites, because they all describe the same 'extreme amino terminus' position with no distinct residue numbers that would distinguish separate junctions.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length α2C-AR coding region fused in-frame with EGFP (six-aa spacer); the C-terminus (position 462, Q) lies in the intracellular region 441–462 per topology landmarks — not an extracellular surface-tag site.
